description: TY2026: what one $200,000 employee costs the employer in federal payroll tax — 6.2% of the $184,500 SSA base (11,439) + 1.45% Medicare on all wages (2,900; the employer does NOT match the 0.9% additional tax) + net-0.6% FUTA on the first $7,000 ($42, unchanged since 1983). Total $14,381.00.
